scenario_description: A genuine checkout/payment authorization failure: Prometheus shows a real nonzero 5xx rate, Loki shows real payment-service error log lines, and the model's own hypothesis cites that real evidence with high confidence and no missing evidence -- this is the ground-truth-positive case classify_investigation's own well_supported bar exists for.

provenance.notes: Evidence text is constructed to mirror the real shape of Phase 2/4's own CheckoutServerErrors telemetry (see observability/prometheus/rules/alerts.yml and scripts/simulate-failure.sh's payment-outage scenario) -- not captured from a live run, but modeled on it. Labeled synthetic per Gate B's own instruction; never claimed as observed production truth.

ground_truth_rationale: A human reviewer confirms: the hypothesis is grounded in two real, current-incident evidence items (E2 Prometheus, E3 Loki) that are mutually consistent (both indicate payment-service failures), the model declared high confidence, and no evidence source was unavailable and nothing is flagged missing -- classify_investigation's own well_supported bar should be met honestly, not because the harness lowered the bar to make this case pass.

hypotheses.statement: payment-service's downstream authorization call is failing, causing checkout-service's 5xx responses.

suggested_checks.description: check payment-service's own authorization dependency health dashboard
suggested_checks.rationale: narrow the failure to the authorization call specifically

evidence.detail: payment-service logs show repeated "downstream authorization call failed" error lines during the incident window

acceptable_variations: the exact wording of the hypothesis statement may vary across providers; only the structural fields (confidence, supporting_evidence_ids, missing_evidence, source_outcomes) govern classify_investigation's own output
forbidden_outcomes: classification of 'inconclusive' or 'partial' would mean classify_investigation's own well_supported bar regressed or this fixture's own shape drifted from the real schema
